label_defs.name: Invoice Header
label_defs.instructions: Header-level fields of the supplier invoice.

moon_form.name: Invoice Total
moon_form.instructions: The grand total payable on the invoice, including tax.

label_defs.instructions: One entry per line item row on the invoice.

moon_form.instructions: The line item description as printed on the row.

moon_form.name: Purchase Order Number
moon_form.instructions: The purchase order number referenced on the line item row.
